name: Universal Viewport Profiles
summary: One viewport surface with multiple camera and interaction policies: sculpt, orbit, and fly.

modes.label: Sculpt
modes.description: Primary edit mode. Left-drag applies brush strokes, right-drag rotates, wheel zooms.

modes.label: Orbit
modes.description: Inspection mode with damped orbit controls and no active brush.

modes.label: Fly
modes.description: Pointer-locked roam through the giant void using WASD plus vertical thrust.
